title: Florida Road Three Bedroom Apartment
description: A spotless three bedroom apartment on Florida Road, a short walk from the best restaurants and coffee spots in Morningside. Perfect for families and small groups.

title: Ocean Luxury at The Quays
description: Wake up to wide ocean and harbour views from this stylish apartment at The Quays. Open plan living, a big balcony and the promenade right on your doorstep.

title: The Sails Beach Apartment
description: Direct beach access and secure parking at The Sails. Spend the day on the sand and the evening watching the sunset over the city.

title: Durban North Beach Hideaway
description: A private little hideaway a few minutes from the beach, surrounded by a lush garden. Ideal for couples who want a quiet coastal escape.

title: Ocean Vistas Two Bedroom Apartment
description: A modern two bedroom apartment with sea views, a private balcony and air conditioning. Close to Gateway, the beach and the Umhlanga promenade.

title: Sea Lodge Beach Apartment
description: Relaxed beachfront living with direct access to the sand. Listen to the waves from the lounge and enjoy sundowners on the patio.

title: The Millennial Umhlanga Apartment
description: A modern and elegant apartment in The Millennial building, walking distance to Gateway Theatre of Shopping and great restaurants.

title: Bermudas Ocean View Apartment
description: Sweeping ocean views from the ninth floor, a short stroll to the lighthouse and the promenade. Plenty of space for the whole family.

title: Morningside Two Bedroom Apartment
description: A comfortable and secure apartment in Morningside, close to Sandton City and the Gautrain. Fast wifi and a dedicated workspace for business travellers.

title: Contemporary Sandown Apartment
description: Contemporary city living in the heart of Sandown. Walk to Nelson Mandela Square and enjoy a modern, beautifully finished space.

title: The Jasmine Sandton
description: A calm and cosy one bedroom apartment in Sandton with everything you need for a short business trip or a city weekend.

title: Elegant Sandton Apartment with Pool
description: An elegant two bedroom, two bathroom apartment in a secure complex with a pool, minutes from the Sandton business district.

title: Modern Three Bedroom Sandton Apartment
description: Modern, stylish and spacious. Three bedrooms and two bathrooms close to Sandton City, ideal for families and colleagues travelling together.

title: Spacious Menlyn Maine Villa
description: A large family home near Menlyn Maine with a sunny garden, pool and braai area. Plenty of room for everyone to spread out.

title: Brooklyn Modern Apartment
description: A neat and modern apartment in Brooklyn, close to the University of Pretoria, Brooklyn Mall and the embassies.

title: The KoDi Pod
description: A beautifully styled private pod with its own bathroom, air conditioning and a quiet garden setting in the east of Pretoria.

title: Romantic Cottage with Hot Tub
description: A romantic retreat with a wood fired hot tub under the stars. Perfect for anniversaries, birthdays and quiet weekends away.

title: Olive Tree Courtyard Suite
description: A peaceful suite opening onto a leafy courtyard with an old olive tree. Close to Menlyn and the Pretoria National Botanical Garden.

title: Table View Family Home
description: A warm and modern family home in Table View, a few minutes from the beach with views of Table Mountain across the bay.

title: Rooftop Pool City Apartment
description: A stylish apartment in the heart of the city with a rooftop pool and panoramic views of Table Mountain and the harbour.

title: Stylish City Apartment with Balcony
description: Sip your morning coffee on the balcony and walk to the best cafes, bars and markets in the city centre.

title: Table Mountain View Apartment
description: Wake up to Table Mountain from your bed. Rooftop pools, trendy Woodstock on your doorstep and a short drive to the V and A Waterfront.

title: Bloubergstrand Beachfront Apartment
description: A bright beachfront apartment with the famous postcard view of Table Mountain across the bay. Kite surfers, sunsets and long beach walks.

title: Charming Garden Flat
description: A peaceful garden flat in the historic centre of Stellenbosch. Stroll to wine bars, galleries and restaurants, or explore the winelands.

title: La Petite Luciole Villa
description: Mountain views, a sparkling pool and an easy walk into the village for world class food and wine.

title: Private Garden Suite
description: A private suite with its own garden, a comfortable queen bed and a short walk to the wine tram.

title: Woolly Bear Forest Cabin
description: A wooden cabin tucked into the Hogsback forest with a large deck and a wood fired hot tub. Slow mornings, birdsong and fresh mountain air.

title: Ballito Three Bedroom Apartment
description: A brand new upper floor apartment with three bedrooms, close to Ballito's beaches, tidal pools and shopping.

title: Dolphin Coast Apartment with Pool
description: A relaxed two bedroom apartment on the Dolphin Coast with a pool and gym in the estate. Watch for dolphins from the beach.

title: Crab Island Studio
description: A light filled studio on Thesen Islands, a short walk to the Knysna Waterfront, oyster bars and lagoon cruises.

title: Thesen Island Canal House
description: A holiday home right on the Thesen Island canals with its own jetty. Paddle, swim and braai with the whole family.

title: Voelklip Seaside Apartment
description: A friendly seaside apartment in Voelklip, close to Grotto Beach and the cliff path for world famous whale watching.

title: Whale and Wildflower House
description: A spacious home surrounded by fynbos, with whales visible from the garden in season. Walk to the old harbour and the village.

title: Oasis Clarens
description: A peaceful home in the jewel of the Free State, surrounded by sandstone mountains and a short walk to the village square.

title: High on a Hill Guesthouse
description: A cosy guesthouse high on the hill with a bird's eye view over Clarens and the Maluti mountains.

title: Winelands Garden Studio
description: A cosy studio with a private garden entrance, close to the university and the town centre.
